subject: Starter package exception for LaunchLabs cohort - allowance request
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara@launchlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter package exception for LaunchLabs cohort - allowance request

Hi Hannah,

Hope you're well — LaunchLabs is kicking off our Summer cohort (12 teams) and we've been evaluating inference partners for host/inference credits as part of the program. Historically we get a small promotional allowance to seed teams during demo day and initial build weeks.

Rough estimate: 12 teams, 2–3 prototypes each, roughly 30k–40k tokens/team over the first month (we can share more detailed usage later). Given the cohort size, would Redwood consider a one-time starter allowance larger than your standard promo — we'd love to offer teams an expanded trial to increase usage and the likelihood of a long-term customer relationship.

Attaching a brief on the cohort (cohort_brief.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — we have a few teams that could be pilot candidates next week.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez
Program Director, LaunchLabs
sara@launchlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

[attachment: cohort_brief.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@launchlabs.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter package exception for LaunchLabs cohort - allowance request

Hi Sara — great to hear from you and congrats on the cohort. Really appreciate the context and the usage estimate.

Quick proposal to get us moving:
- Step 1: We run a 1-team pilot for 2 weeks (no charge) so we can validate workload patterns.
- Step 2: If pilot looks good, Redwood can offer a one-time starter allowance of 25k tokens for the cohort (to be split across teams) + prioritized onboarding support.
- Step 3: We agree a shared usage reporting cadence and a case study/quote from LaunchLabs in exchange for an expanded allowance.

I'll loop in Rafael on whether we can stretch the allowance higher and send a draft SOW. Can you also share a simple per-team usage breakdown (a spreadsheet is perfect)?

Attaching initial draft of our terms for cohort pilots (LAUNCH_TERMS_DRAFT.pdf) — this is just internal draft.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai

[attachment: LAUNCH_TERMS_DRAFT.pdf]

Thanks for the note, Hannah / Sara. I can approve an exception for accelerator customers but we'd like to structure it to protect unit economics. Proposal from my side:

- Starter allowance: 40k free tokens for the cohort (one-time).
- Commitment: a short, 3-month ramp commitment at a 10% discounted consumption rate after allowance is exhausted OR a nominal reserved capacity minimum for the first month.
- Case study + public partnership mention in co-marketing materials as part of the agreement.

If LaunchLabs wants to avoid a commit, we can trade down to 25k allowance + 15% discount for 2 months. Also copying Monica for procurement/legal to fast-track a lightweight SOW.

Hannah — is this something you want to surface to Sara as the formal offer? I think we can close quickly if LaunchLabs is willing to commit to a short-term consumption plan.

Rafael
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Starter package exception for LaunchLabs cohort - allowance request

Thanks, Rafael — this is helpful and closer to what we had in mind. A few clarifying points from LaunchLabs:

- We'd prefer the higher allowance without a hard reserved capacity minimum; LaunchLabs is trying to stay flexible for cohort teams.
- We can commit to a 3-month promotional partnership (case study + quote) but need per-team allocation flexibility.
- Billing: can you confirm whether the discount applies organization-wide (all teams under LaunchLabs) or per project/team?

We attached a quick usage estimate sheet back-of-envelope to illustrate per-team variation (cohort_usage_estimates.xlsx). We are open to a pilot with one team first if that helps accelerate approval.

Happy to take a brief call today or tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Sara

[attachment: cohort_usage_estimates.xlsx]

Hi Sara / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the spreadsheet. Quick update from pricing/legal side after a brief check-in:

Final offer (to expedite):
- One-time starter allowance: 35,000 free tokens for the cohort (one-time, poolable across teams).
- Introductory consumption discount: 12% off pay-as-you-go for the first 4 months after the allowance is consumed.
- Per-team allocation: LaunchLabs can carve the pool as needed per team; we will provide a single billing account for LaunchLabs and share usage rollups weekly.
- Next steps: we'll generate a lightweight SOW and route via DocuSign. SOW draft attached (custom_starter_sow_v1.pdf).

We can also start a 1-team pilot immediately if you want to test performance and onboarding workflows. If this aligns, I'll open the HubSpot deal and send the DocuSign link.
